description: In OrientDB Studio (http://localhost:2480/studio/index.html), connect to the 'demodb' database (username: root, password: GymAnything123!). Navigate to the Browse tab and select the 'Countries' class. Insert a new record in the Countries class with the following field values: Name='Portugal', Type='European'. You can use the '+' (New Record) button in the Browse tab, or use the Execute Script tab to run an SQL INSERT command. Save the record.
